name: primitives-headless-popover

frames.best_why: The panel is fully open below the closed trigger, with all copy and the Save changes button at full size.

tagline: A small button drops down a settings card with a save action.
summary: A Quick settings button opens a small floating card with a short explanation and a Save changes button; the card scales up from the trigger and shrinks away on close.
appearance: A compact outlined button on black labelled Quick settings. Below it sits a floating dark card with the same heading, two lines of grey copy and a full-width white Save changes button.
behaviour: Clicking the button pops the card open beneath it, growing from half scale with a spring while it fades in. Clicking again, or outside, shrinks it back toward the button.
demo_content: A Quick settings button and a panel saying Adjust preferences from here, with a Save changes button.
search_phrases: small panel that pops open below a button
click button to show a floating card
hover card with a save button
popup that grows from the trigger
use_when: A few settings or a short note should open in place without leaving the page.
avoid_when: The panel is narrow and its content is fixed, so longer forms or lists will not fit.
customise: Compose the trigger, panel and optional backdrop with your own markup, and set the transition or placement; the scale-and-fade animation is fixed.
weight_why: One small panel scaling in; nothing runs while closed.

a11y.note: Escape closes and focus is managed, but the demo removes the focus outline without a ring, so keyboard focus is invisible.

issues: The description is small grey text with low contrast on the dark card.
The trigger looks depressed while open, with nothing else signalling the open state.
polish_why: Clean card and a neat scale-in; the small grey description is the main weak point.
title: Headless Popover
